g.text: Channel-connector topology — grant-based external interfaces around the Agent-Teams env v3
One env, one atomicity domain: grants, bindings, and runs
share the insertSigned env so beginDurableRunUnderGrant can
adjudicate the grant, count the day cap, and register the
run in a single Rholang join. Channel caches are routing
artifacts; the chain is the verifier of record.
